heading: Two clocks. Clear limits.
intro: Calendar deadlines decide when a learner must finish; work limits decide how much extra work they can add. Each level can only be stricter than the one above it.

envelope.body: How much extra learning work this learner can add on the path to the chosen level: planned minutes, episodes and practice rounds per concept. A level without its own limit uses the one above it.
envelope.notice: Extra calendar days do not add minutes, episodes or practice rounds. Raising a work limit needs its own offer, with its own terms and approval.
